# on-prem deployment -- generated by fde-framework

This project was emitted from an engagement profile. Every decision
in it is traced in [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md); every risk
accepted along the way is in [RISKS.md](RISKS.md).

## Run the evaluation

```bash
python evals/harness.py --min-score 0.9
```

It is red for exactly the reasons it prints: an empty golden set
(seed pairs with `fde samples` and rebuild), a component that is
not yet wired (an OCR engine, a tool registry, a model endpoint --
each says so on first use), or a score below the bar. CI gates at
`--min-score 0.0` -- no regression -- until the number above is
earned; then raise it there. The components under `app/components/`
carry reference implementations and their contracts; finish them by
hand, or drive a coding agent against the harness with `fde implement .`
(the evals, the boundary and the decision documents are fenced --
an agent that edits them is caught and reverted).

## Run it locally

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e . pytest
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/        # the model-free smoke
# The edge refuses to boot misconfigured (exit 78, one line). Minimum:
export AUTH_TOKEN=change-me LLM_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:11434 LLM_MODEL=<name>
export CORPUS_DIR=./corpus                   # where a retrieval layer reads from
PORT=8080 .venv/bin/python -m app.service   # the service
curl -s localhost:8080/health; curl -s localhost:8080/ready
curl -s -X POST localhost:8080/ -H 'Authorization: Bearer change-me' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '"a question, or an object"'
```

Variables a build does not read are commented out in `deploy/env.example`.

## What CI does and does not do

The workflow runs the deliverable's own tests on every push, model-free.
The evaluation gates at `--min-score 0.0` (no regression) and is red
until the exam is seeded from the client's pairs -- an empty exam is
red on purpose. A judged evaluation needs a model; on a build whose
data may not leave it runs only on a self-hosted runner labelled
`inside-boundary`, never on a hosted one, and its score is not quotable
until `evals/calibrate.py` passes. The out-of-sample gate is a second
job that runs only on a self-hosted runner holding the engagement's
holdout at the path the repository variable `HOLDOUT_PATH` names; until
then the golden score is the only one CI sees. `fde scorecard <project>
--holdout <file>` measures the same things by hand and writes
`SCORECARD.md`.

## The pieces

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `app/pipeline.py` | The payload path: ingest and request steps, approval gates, critics, the envelope in and the output out |
| `app/service.py` | The HTTP edge the deploy runs: identity, request ids, framing, status codes, readiness, drain |
| `app/shapes.py` | The envelope every step reads and writes, and the refusals for input that is not it |
| `app/ledger.py` | Append-only audit and idempotency keys under STATE_DIR -- present when anything outward was decided |
| `app/components/` | One module per decided component: reference implementations, or scaffolds that raise with their contract |
| `app/contract.py` | RefusedInput -- forbidden input is refused, never guessed at |
| `app/controls.py` | Approval gates and critics, fail-closed -- present when anything mutative was decided |
| `app/boundary.py` | Placement of every step, asserted at import -- present when data may not leave |
| `app/llm.py` | The one model touchpoint -- present when a decision needs a model |
| `evals/` | Golden / edge / adversarial sets from the client's own pairs, the harness, the case schema and acceptance protocol |
| `tests/` | The deliverable's own model-free smoke |
| `deploy/` | The substrate this profile earned, its install path, and how to tear it down |
| `ops/` | Runbook keyed to the failure taxonomy, SLOs, rollback |

Regenerating from the same facts reproduces this project byte for
byte; a diff between two builds means a decision changed.
